This lesson covers Uses of body parts Head Mouth Nose Eyes Legs Hands Ears, part of Myself 1.1 External body parts • Head • Mouth • Nose • Eyes • Legs • Hands • Ear in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: which body parts are in use. ● Learners are guided to name uses of body parts (mouth, eyes, legs, hands and ears). How do we use body parts?

Values:
